scripts.build: pnpm boundaries:check && pnpm --filter iteration-trace-contracts build && pnpm --filter iteration-trace-postgres build && pnpm --filter iteration-trace-collector build && pnpm --filter @useiteration/trace-vault-collector build && pnpm --filter trace-vault build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter iteration-trace-contracts exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter iteration-trace-postgres exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter iteration-trace-collector exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter trace-vault exec tsc --noEmit
